entries.meaning: Series-dependent: on HSCE14FS models it means the dishwasher is taking too long to fill with water; on HV60340UK and H15DSS models it means the door was opened during operation.
entries.source: Hisense HSCE14FS/HSCE14FB user manual; Hisense HV60340UK manual; Hisense H15DSS manual

entries.meaning: Series-dependent: on HSCE14FS models the water is not reaching the required temperature (heating problem); on H15DSS/HV60340UK models it is a water drainage malfunction.
entries.source: Hisense HSCE14FS user manual; Hisense H15DSS manual; Hisense HV60340UK manual

entries.meaning: A control button was pressed or touched continuously for more than 30 seconds.
entries.source: Hisense HSCE14FS user manual; Insignia (Hisense-built) dishwasher FAQ

entries.meaning: Series-dependent: on top-load HW-K60B/HWT3K8065B models it is a drainage error (water not drained after about 15 minutes); a front-load error table lists it as a water filling error.
entries.source: Hisense HW-K60B / HWT3K8065B manuals; Hisense front-load error code table

entries.meaning: Draining fault: waste water is not being pumped out. A second documented meaning (overflow / high water level) exists in some Hisense documentation.
entries.source: Hisense WFXE6012-series manual; Hisense WFPV7012MT manual

entries.meaning: Water fill problem: the water level sensor frequency is not changing, or the machine does not fill within the set time.
entries.source: Daewoo washing machine service error code list

entries.meaning: Initial-operation error: the Hall IC / motor connection signal is abnormal and the motor stops.
entries.source: Daewoo washing machine service error code list

entries.meaning: Wash water temperature sensor fault: the sensor circuit is open or short-circuited.
entries.source: Daewoo washing machine service error code list

entries.meaning: Overflow or leak protection activated: too much water in the tub or a leak has been detected, and the drain pump runs.
entries.source: Midea dishwasher manuals, including US model MDT24P4AST

entries.meaning: Refrigerant leakage detection on Midea U-shaped window air conditioners (displayed EL OC / EL0C). Refrigerant work is technician-only.
entries.source: Midea U-series window AC documentation

entries.meaning: Series-dependent: on the HW80-B14979 front-load model it is a door lock error; on the HWM90DD top-load model the top lid is not closed during the wash.
entries.source: Haier HW80-B14979 manual; Haier HWM90DD manual

entries.meaning: Water inlet malfunction on H15DSS and HV60340UK models. Note: the HSCE14FS/HSCE14FB family has no E2 — inlet faults there show as E1.
entries.source: Hisense H15DSS manual; Hisense HV60340UK manual p.11; Hisense HSCE14FS/HSCE14FB instruction manual

entries.meaning: Series-dependent: temperature sensor malfunction (H15DSS, HV60340UK) or overflow / anti-flood activation from a leak in the base (HSCE14FS/HSCE14FB).
entries.source: Hisense H15DSS manual; Hisense HV60340UK manual p.11; Hisense HSCE14FS/HSCE14FB instruction manual

entries.meaning: Drain fault: the water level did not reach the reset point after drainage started. Some Daewoo families show QE for the same fault (water not draining for more than 15 minutes).
entries.source: Daewoo D-CV701PC series service manual; Daewoo D-MU123 user manual; Daewoo washing machine service error-code document

entries.meaning: Unbalance error: the load is unevenly distributed; the machine tried to rebalance itself twice during spin and gave up, tripping the unbalance switch.
entries.source: Daewoo washing machine service error-code document; Daewoo D-MU123 user manual

entries.meaning: E9 = water-level sensor fault: sensor frequency above 30 kHz or below 15 kHz, a sudden >1.44 kHz jump after filling, or the sensor hose disconnected. Daewoo manuals route E9 to the service center.
entries.source: Daewoo Washing Machine Error Codes service document; Daewoo DWD-M301WP Wall-Mounted Front Load Washer User Manual (2025)

entries.meaning: Longer inlet time: the inlet valve has been open about 4 minutes without enough water entering; consistent across Midea dishwasher model families.
entries.source: Midea MDT24P4AST/MDT24P6CST user manuals; Midea Smart Dishwasher (Model 340607) and MDP18B10AWWC manuals; Midea MFD60S120X-HR manual; Midea dishwasher technical service manual

entries.meaning: Drainage failure on all families that use E1: blocked drain hose (top-load HWM/HWT families) or clogged pump filter (European HW-B1426 front-load family). The HW80/HW100/HW120-B14979 and HWF85ANB1/HWF90ANB1 families do not use E1 — drainage faults there show as CLR FLTR.
entries.source: Haier HWM90DD user manual; Haier HWM120-1678ES5 manual; Haier HWM170-B278S6 manual; Haier AU HWT09/HWT10/HWT12 top-loader guide; Haier official EG/AE top-load manuals; Haier HW70B1426, HW90B14266A, HW90BP14636 front-load manuals; Haier HWF85ANB1/HWD80-B14979 manuals

entries.meaning: F1 = refrigerator (R1) sensor malfunction: short circuit or open/broken circuit. Codes are recalled with a 3-button sequence on HB21F models; shown directly on HRF-663 models.
entries.source: Haier HB21FWRSS Refrigerator Service Manual (EDITION 2008-03-24); Haier HRF-663ISB2 Service Manual (Issue 20090416, Ref0904S016V0)

entries.meaning: Chassis water filling fault: the anti-flood float switch detected water in the machine's base/chassis; the error algorithm activates, the cycle ends, and the machine tries to discharge the water. On models without a display the same fault blinks P1 with the power LED flashing.
entries.source: Beko BDIS16030 user manual; Beko BDIN38460 manual; Beko BDIN4S560WP manual; Beko Australia official dishwasher support

entries.meaning: The machine may not be taking in water (Beko's manuals label this fault E8 — your display shows E08).
entries.source: Beko BM3WFSU39413W/BM3WFSU39413WPBB1 user manual; Beko BM1WFSU37233WPBB user manual; Beko BM3WFSU48415WPBB2 user manual; Beko B7WFU69418WB user manual; Beko BMWU3821W user manual

entries.meaning: E1 = communication malfunction between the indoor and outdoor units (no feedback for 110 seconds, happening 4 times). Check wiring first; the S-to-N voltage test is technician work.
entries.source: Midea High Wall System Error Codes and Fault Diagnosis Guide; Midea Air Conditioner Owner's Manual (document 16122500000082, 20150328)

entries.meaning: EC = refrigerant leak detection: the T2 coil temperature fails to drop after the compressor starts (8-minute/3-times trigger logic). Power-cycle only; pressure, leak and recharge work is technician-only.
entries.source: Midea High Wall System Error Codes and Fault Diagnosis Guide; Midea MSAG-10CRN8 Room Air Conditioner User Manual; Midea Ductless Split Unit System Owner's Manual

entries.meaning: H3 = compressor overload protection on mini-split families (low charge, blocked capillary, compressor motor, loose OVC-COMP terminal; outdoor unit flashes 8×). On GMV VRF platforms H3 = fan drive module reset protection instead.
entries.source: Gree NEO series Instruction Manual (Cat DFS-NEO-CO-2IN, 2014); Gree Livo LIVS18HP230V1BH manual; Gree Ceiling Cassette Owner's Manual; Gree GMV6 Mini DC Inverter VRF Service Manual

entries.meaning: Series split: on top-loaders (HW-K60B, HWT3K8065B) E4 = too-long-to-fill water supply fault (check tap, hose, and drain-hose height ≥90 cm); on front-load E-series (WFQY9014EVJM) E4 = motor error. F-code front-loads have no E4.
entries.source: Hisense HWT3K8065B 3K 8kg Top Load User Guide; Hisense HW-K60B Fully Automatic User Manual; Hisense WFQY9014EVJM Front-Load User Manual; Hisense WF3S8046BW Front-Load User Manual

entries.meaning: E:02 = water cut-off warning: mains water cut or inlet tap closed. The programme pauses and resumes by itself when water is restored — no reset needed. Do not confuse with E:01 (overflowing).
entries.source: Beko DFN26210W user manual (official beko.com PDF); Beko DDT38532XIHHW user manual (USA); Beko DSN28430X / DIN48430 / BDBU1430X37 / BDIS38122Q / BDIN38640C user manuals

entries.meaning: E05 = drainage fault: the pump filter is likely clogged. The manual's fix order: clean the pump filter, retry in a spin cycle, then call service. E08 is the inlet-side code.
entries.source: Beko B5WFU69415MB2 ES user manual; Beko BMGWU4941B user manual; Beko BM3WFU410415WPBB user manual; Beko BM1WFSU37233WPBB user manual; Beko BMW9149DB user manual

entries.meaning: LE = the door was opened while the machine was running (front-loader DWD families). Close the door and the course continues by itself. Not the same as DE (door-lock solenoid fault); top-loaders use E2, not LE.
entries.source: Daewoo Washing Machine Error Codes service document; Daewoo DWD-M301WP user manual; Daewoo DWD-M221MB user manual

entries.meaning: F2 = freezer sensor malfunction (F SNR short or open circuit) on the HB21F family. On HRF-663/664 and HRF-628 families Haier's manuals list F2 with no defined meaning — the family split matters.
entries.source: Haier HB21FWRSS Refrigerator Service Manual (EDITION 2008-03-24); Haier HRF-370F user manual

entries.meaning: E3 = safety switch acted: the machine cannot spin (imbalance fault after two automatic rebalancing attempts). Top-load families only — B14979 front-loads use 'Unb'. Manual fix: redistribute load, open/close lid once, level the machine.
entries.source: Haier HWM160-B278S6 user manual (download.haier.com); Haier HWM70-0588H / HWM50-10H / HWM8000 / XQS70-98 / XQSB60-JN / HWM70-A / 50FREE-3B / HWM-6.5/S / HWM6815 user manuals

entries.meaning: E4 = water level not reached in time (fill timeout: 12 min B14979 front-load, ~15 min top-loads). Manual checklist: tap, pressure, inlet hose/filter. Distinct from FA (sensor) and E8 (self-syphoning).
entries.source: Haier HW80/HW100/HW120-B14979 front-load user manual; Haier HWM160-B278S6 user manual (download.haier.com); Haier top-load family manuals

entries.meaning: Series split: on top-loaders (HWT3K8065B, HW-K60B) E1 = lid not closed (open/close lid + Start/Pause); on front-load E-series (WFQY9014EVJM) E1 = temperature sensor error. F-code front-loads have no E1.
entries.source: Hisense HWT3K8065B 3K 8kg Top Load User Guide; Hisense HW-K60B Fully Automatic User Manual; Hisense WFQY9014EVJM Front-Load User Manual

entries.meaning: E2 = door lock error on front-load families (WFQY9014EVJM, WFGE90141VM): close the door, unplug/replug, restart. E2 does not exist on Hisense top-loaders. The manual also defines E22 (cannot lock) and E23 (cannot unlock).
entries.source: Hisense WFQY9014EVJM Front-Load User Manual; Hisense WFGE90141VM Front-Load User Manual

entries.meaning: F0 = overcurrent protection: an abnormal current rise detected in the current detection circuit. F0 is NOT the refrigerant-leak code (that is EC) — the 'F0 = leak' claim is Gree-family contamination. F0 straight after power-up on standby points to the outdoor PCB.
entries.source: Midea High Wall System Error Codes and Fault Diagnosis Guide; Midea Air Conditioner Owner's Manual (16122500000082, 20150328)

entries.meaning: P1 = over-voltage or under-voltage protection (abnormal voltage rise/drop in the detection circuit). Check the mains supply first; if good, the rectifier or outdoor ebox/PCB is faulty. Not the portable-AC 'tray full' code.
entries.source: Midea MSV1-12HRFN1-MT0W service manual (Vertu series); Midea High Wall System Error Codes and Fault Diagnosis Guide

entries.meaning: P4 = inverter compressor drive error (abnormal drive signal). Causes: wiring mistakes, IPM fault, outdoor fan motor, compressor, outdoor PCB, surge — or bad commissioning (no vacuum drying) on new installs. Indoor display P4; outdoor display maps it to inverter module protection.
entries.source: Midea High Wall System Error Codes and Fault Diagnosis Guide; Midea MSV1-12HRFN1-MT0W service manual (Vertu series)

entries.meaning: E5 means an overflow/leakage fault: the manual's cause column says 'Overflow occurs / Water leakage occurs.' When the system detects an overflow it shuts off the circulation pump and turns on the drain pump. On the H15DS
entries.source: Hisense H15DSS Dishwasher User Manual (official PDF via hisense.co.za, 190520 DW-0359-450); Hisense HV60340UK User's Operation Manual (manualslib, page 11); Hisense HSCE14FS/HSCE14FB Instruction Manual (manualspro transcription)

entries.source: Hisense H15DSS Dishwasher User Manual (official PDF via hisense.co.za, 190520 DW-0359-450); Hisense HV60340UK User's Operation Manual (manualslib, page 11); Hisense HSCE14FS/HSCE14FB Instruction Manual (manualspro transcription)

entries.meaning: E7 means a heating-element fault: the manual's cause column says 'Abnormal heating.' On the H15DSS and HV60340UK families this is a documented code; on HSCE14FS/HSCE14FB there is no E7 — the heating fault there is E3 ('N
entries.source: Hisense H15DSS Dishwasher User Manual (official PDF via hisense.co.za, 190520 DW-0359-450); Hisense HV60340UK User's Operation Manual (manualslib, page 11); Hisense HSCE14FS/HSCE14FB Instruction Manual (manualspro transcription)

entries.meaning: P5 means an indoor-units mode conflict: on a multi-zone system, the indoor units are set to incompatible modes — one in HEATING while another is in COOLING — and the system refuses to run both at once. Every Midea mini-s
entries.source: Midea MSV1I09HRDN1 service manual (MSV1I series, 3D DC Inverter Split Wall-Mounted); Midea Air Conditioner Owner's Manual (manuals.plus); Midea service manual (All-c-Pg-and-Cpp-Service-Manual, scribd doc 411737552); Midea DLCSRB Single Zone Ductless System Instruction Manual; Midea For 9000 Ductless Split Unit System Owner's Manual (Midea America Corp.)

entries.source: Gree R32 Slim Duct Mini Split System Owner's Manual (GFH(09)DA-D6DNA1A/I, GFH(12)DA-D6DNA1A/I, GFH(18)DB-D6DNA1A/I, GFH(21)DB-D6DNA1A/I, GFH(24)DB-D6DNA1A/I); Gree Fairy Inverter Series R32 / Comfort Pro Service Manual JF00305582 (GWH09ACCXB-K6DNA1G, GWH12ACCXD-K6DNA1D, GWH18ACDXF-K6DNA1C, GWH18ACDXF-K6DNA1D, GWH24ACEXF-K6DNA1A); Gree Dry Contact & 24 Volt Adaptor Owner's Manual ME33-42/G

entries.source: Gree R32 Slim Duct Mini Split System Owner's Manual (GFH(09)DA-D6DNA1A/I, GFH(12)DA-D6DNA1A/I, GFH(18)DB-D6DNA1A/I, GFH(21)DB-D6DNA1A/I, GFH(24)DB-D6DNA1A/I); Gree Vireo owner's/troubleshooting manual (VIR09HP115V1A–VIR36HP230V1A); Gree Dry Contact & 24 Volt Adaptor Owner's Manual ME33-42/G

entries.source: Midea Dishwasher Technical Service Manual — Troubleshooting and Repair Guide (PCB model 7601S platform); Shunde Midea Dishwasher Manufacturing Co., Ltd. maintenance manual (model WQP8-B9252)

entries.source: Midea Dishwasher Technical Service Manual — Troubleshooting and Repair Guide (PCB model 7601S platform); Shunde Midea Dishwasher Manufacturing Co., Ltd. maintenance manual (model WQP8-B9252)

entries.meaning: E1 means load imbalance on Daewoo DWF/DQ top-loaders. The manual's own tactic says the machine automatically detects and rearranges the load if it is out of balance — so an occasional E1 is the machine protecting itself,
entries.source: Daewoo Washing Machine User Manual — DWF-9001Q, DWF-1401Q, DWF-1801Q, DWF-2001Q (Daewoo Electronics Sales & Services (M) Sdn Bhd); DAEMA DWF-2028ZD Fully Automatic Washing Machine User Manual (Model DWF-2028ZD)

entries.meaning: E2 means the lid is open on Daewoo DWF/DQ top-loaders. Both Daewoo manuals define it identically, and the manual's tactic is specific: open the lid, put the clothes evenly and symmetrically, then close the lid. It is a s
entries.source: Daewoo Washing Machine User Manual — DWF-9001Q, DWF-1401Q, DWF-1801Q, DWF-2001Q (Daewoo Electronics Sales & Services (M) Sdn Bhd); DAEMA DWF-2028ZD Fully Automatic Washing Machine User Manual (Model DWF-2028ZD)

entries.meaning: E3 means the water sensor is abnormal on Daewoo DWF/DQ top-loaders. Both Daewoo manuals define it identically, and the manual's tactic is a single line: 'Contact our service department.' There is no user-serviceable fix
entries.source: Daewoo Washing Machine User Manual — DWF-9001Q, DWF-1401Q, DWF-1801Q, DWF-2001Q (Daewoo Electronics Sales & Services (M) Sdn Bhd); DAEMA DWF-2028ZD Fully Automatic Washing Machine User Manual (Model DWF-2028ZD)

entries.source: Daewoo Washing Machine User Manual — DWF-9001Q, DWF-1401Q, DWF-1801Q, DWF-2001Q (Daewoo Electronics Sales & Services (M) Sdn Bhd); DAEMA DWF-2028ZD Fully Automatic Washing Machine User Manual (Model DWF-2028ZD)

entries.meaning: E6 on a Daewoo DWF top-loader means Child Protection: the lid was opened after the Child Lock function was set. Close the lid properly (first making sure any child is a safe distance away) and the warning clears. This is
entries.source: Daewoo DWF-9001Q/1401Q/1801Q/2001Q Washing Machine User Manual (Auto Alarm table); Daewoo DWF-7002FL Washing Machine User Manual (Error Digital Display Information); Daewoo Washing Machine Service Manual, DWD platform (E6 EMG contrast); Daewoo Washing Machine Error Codes PDF, DD front-loader platform (E6 EMG contrast)

entries.source: Arçelik MLCD_BLDC-BL Fault Diagrams (Rev 01, 08.10.2009, prepared by Engin BAYATLI, Recep SERÇE); Arçelik BX B7S BXBLED BL Washing Machine Service Manual No:1 (WTK92151W)

entries.source: Arçelik MLCD_BLDC-BL Fault Diagrams (Rev 01, 08.10.2009, prepared by Engin BAYATLI, Recep SERÇE); Arçelik BX B7S BXBLED BL Washing Machine Service Manual No:1 (WTK92151W)
