entries.meaning: Defrost sensor fault in the variable chamber (BMF No Frost service manual + ZLINE cross-brand confirmation)
entries.source: Midea Service Manual REF MDRE411FGE01 §9.7 (BMF No Frost, MDRE411FG) + ZLINE RFM-W / RSMZW36BSCB manuals

entries.meaning: Water supply error — icemaker/dispenser water-supply fault on FRS-platform side-by-sides
entries.source: Daewoo Service Manual S/M FRS2011000 (FRS-2011/2031) + FRS-T20DA* service manual §5

entries.meaning: Water supply fault — water level cannot reach reset level within 5 min (XQG50/HWD1000 combo platform)
entries.source: Haier XQG50-S1216 user manual + Haier HWD1000 washer & dryer user manual + Haier XQG50-S1016 operation manual

entries.meaning: Water-supply overfill — water above the warning level; technician-only (XQG50/HWD1000 combo platform)
entries.source: Haier XQG50-S1216 user manual + Haier HWD1000 washer & dryer user manual + Haier XQG50-S1016 operation manual

entries.meaning: Drainage error, water not emptied — clean pump filter, check drain hose (4 manuals; B14979 shows it as E1/CLR FLTR)
entries.source: Haier HW70-B1426/S + HW08-CP1439S + INTELIUS 500/HW80BD + HWD100-BD1499U1 user manuals

entries.meaning: Water overflow / overflow protection — top-load platform only; manuals route straight to Customer Care
entries.source: Haier HWM90DD + HWM200-M1990DD + HWM100-316S6/S8 (download.haier.com) + GWT950AW + HWM200-1678 manuals

entries.meaning: Communication failure between indoor and outdoor units (4 factory generations: evo, Change 18/24, NEO, official Livo Gen4)
entries.source: GREE evo owner's manual + GREE Change 18/24 service manual §9.3 + Gree Livo Gen4 service manual (greecomfort.com) §9.1 + Gree NEO installation manual

entries.meaning: Compressor phase-current detection circuit malfunction — outdoor control board fault (Blueridge/STEALTH Midea-OEM platform)
entries.source: Blueridge Sapphire installation manual + STEALTH SC-09W-HP230 PINNACLE instruction manual (2022) + Seeley Braemar KDHA owner's manual

entries.meaning: Water inflow fault — tap/pressure/hose/filter/frozen-pipe 4-point check (10+ families; F1 = single-digit display variant)
entries.source: Hisense WFN9012 + WF5S1045BB + WFPV7012MT + WDQR1014EVAJM + WFH 8014 user manuals (+ display-variant family WF3S8046BW)

entries.meaning: Water filling exceeded preset time — 4-minute inlet timeout (EGSP p.49 + DDW-MQ1214S tech service manuals)
entries.source: Daewoo EGSP-130E/13E/90E/9E Technical & Service Manual p.49 + Daewoo DDW-MQ1214S Technical Service Manual pp.28–30

entries.meaning: DC bus voltage level dropping malfunction — unstable supply voltage (Blueridge/STEALTH Midea-OEM platform)
entries.source: Blueridge Sapphire installation manual + STEALTH SC-09W-HP230 PINNACLE instruction manual (2022)

entries.meaning: Current detection malfunction — outdoor control board fault (Blueridge/STEALTH Midea-OEM platform)
entries.source: Blueridge Sapphire installation manual + STEALTH SC-09W-HP230 PINNACLE instruction manual (2022)

entries.meaning: Reversing valve malfunction — valve voltage <175V, loose connections, or solenoid (Blueridge/STEALTH Midea-OEM platform)
entries.source: Blueridge Sapphire installation manual + STEALTH SC-09W-HP230 PINNACLE instruction manual (2022)

entries.meaning: Zero crossing detection malfunction — outdoor control board fault (Blueridge/STEALTH Midea-OEM platform)
entries.source: Blueridge Sapphire installation manual + STEALTH SC-09W-HP230 PINNACLE instruction manual (2022)

entries.meaning: Compressor phase-current detection circuit malfunction — replace outdoor control panel AP1 (evo, Change 18/24, Livo Gen4)
entries.source: GREE evo owner's manual + GREE Change 18/24 service manual §9.3 + Gree Livo Gen4 service manual (greecomfort.com) §9.1

entries.meaning: Complete-unit current detection circuit malfunction — replace outdoor control panel AP1 (evo, Change 18/24, Livo Gen4)
entries.source: GREE evo owner's manual + GREE Change 18/24 service manual §9.3 + Gree Livo Gen4 service manual (greecomfort.com) §9.1

entries.meaning: Zero-crossing detection circuit malfunction — series split: evo-only "exhaust sensor disconnection" (Change 18/24, Classic 7-12, Livo Gen4 vs evo)
entries.source: GREE Change 18/24 service manual §9.3/§9.4 + GREE Classic 7-12 technical manual §8 + Gree Livo Gen4 service manual (greecomfort.com) §9.1/§9.2

entries.meaning: DC bus-bar overvoltage protection — factory threshold 265VAC (evo, Change 18/24, Livo Gen4)
entries.source: GREE evo owner's manual + GREE Change 18/24 service manual §9.3 + Gree Livo Gen4 service manual (greecomfort.com) §9.1

entries.meaning: Electronic module fault — F04/F05/F06/F07/F23 are one fault, one 3-step reset (10+ manuals; "F04–F98" catch-all)
entries.source: Hisense WFN9012 + WF5S1045BB + WFPV7012MT + WF3S8046BW + WFH 8014 + WFDJ7010 + WFBJ90121 + WFQP8014EVM/HWFL1014V/WDQR1014EVAJM manuals

entries.meaning: Door lock fault — cannot lock at cycle start; 20-sec PTC procedure (10+ manuals)
entries.source: Hisense WFN9012 + WF5S1045BB + WFPV7012MT + WF3S8046BW user manuals

entries.meaning: Door unlock fault — cannot unlock at cycle end (8+ manuals; absent from WFN9012's older table)
entries.source: Hisense WF5S1045BB + WFPV7012MT + WDQY8014/9014/1014 + WFQP8014EVM user manuals

entries.meaning: Water level reaches overflow level — "too much foam" cause; F02 = alternate display (WFPV7012MT/HWFM8012)
entries.source: Hisense WFN9012 + WF5S1045BB + WFPV7012MT + WF3S8046BW user manuals

entries.meaning: Unbalance alarm — redistribute load, single dehydration programme (10+ manuals; alarm, not a part failure)
entries.source: Hisense WFN9012 + WF5S1045BB + WFPV7012MT + WFQP8014EVM user manuals

entries.meaning: Heating exceeded preset time — 60-min/NTC threshold (EGSP p.49 + DDW-MQ1214S tech service manuals)
entries.source: Daewoo EGSP-130E/13E/90E/9E Technical & Service Manual p.49 + Daewoo DDW-MQ1214S Technical Service Manual pp.28–30

entries.meaning: Overflow — unplug + close tap, service (DA1D5/DA1E6 UK Vestel line)
entries.source: Daewoo DA1D5SI0ES/DA1D5SW0ES + DA1E6FI0ES/DA1E6FW0ES user manuals

entries.meaning: Inability to discharge water — hose/filter check, cancel programme, service (DA1D5/DA1E6 UK Vestel line)
entries.source: Daewoo DA1D5SI0ES/DA1D5SW0ES + DA1E6FI0ES/DA1E6FW0ES user manuals

entries.meaning: Continuous water input — close tap, service (DA1D5/DA1E6 UK Vestel line)
entries.source: Daewoo DA1D5SI0ES/DA1D5SW0ES + DA1E6FI0ES/DA1E6FW0ES user manuals

entries.meaning: Insufficient water — tap open, clean inlet hose filter, service if it continues (DA1D5/DA1E6 UK Vestel line)
entries.source: Daewoo DA1D5SI0ES/DA1D5SW0ES + DA1E6FI0ES/DA1E6FW0ES user manuals

entries.meaning: Faulty heater sensor — service only (DA1D5/DA1E6 UK Vestel line; F6/F7/F8 distinct)
entries.source: Daewoo DA1D5SI0ES/DA1D5SW0ES + DA1E6FI0ES/DA1E6FW0ES user manuals

entries.meaning: Overheating — service only (DA1D5/DA1E6 UK Vestel line; F6/F7/F8 distinct)
entries.source: Daewoo DA1D5SI0ES/DA1D5SW0ES + DA1E6FI0ES/DA1E6FW0ES user manuals

entries.meaning: Heater error — service only (DA1D5/DA1E6 UK Vestel line; E3 values never imported)
entries.source: Daewoo DA1D5SI0ES/DA1D5SW0ES + DA1E6FI0ES/DA1E6FW0ES user manuals

entries.meaning: Faulty electronic card — service only (DA1D5/DA1E6 UK Vestel line)
entries.source: Daewoo DA1D5SI0ES/DA1D5SW0ES + DA1E6FI0ES/DA1E6FW0ES user manuals

entries.meaning: Motor fault — feedback signal unchanged in 8 min while motor runs (XQG50/HWD1000 combo platform)
entries.source: Haier XQG50-S1216 + Haier HWD1000 washer & dryer + Haier XQG50-S1016 manuals

entries.meaning: Water level abnormal in the drying process — drain outlet check + restart (XQG50/HWD1000 combo platform)
entries.source: Haier XQG50-S1216 + Haier HWD1000 washer & dryer + Haier XQG50-S1016 manuals

entries.meaning: Heater — water temp unchanged in 10 min; machine washes cold (XQG50-only)
entries.source: Haier XQG50-S1216 + Haier XQG50-S1016 manuals (HWD1000 table lacks EC1–EC3)

entries.meaning: Water temperature sensor — circuit short/open (XQG50-only; phrase caveat)
entries.source: Haier XQG50-S1216 + Haier XQG50-S1016 manuals (HWD1000 table lacks EC1–EC3)

entries.meaning: Water level sensor — circuit short/open (XQG50-only)
entries.source: Haier XQG50-S1216 + Haier XQG50-S1016 manuals (HWD1000 table lacks EC1–EC3)

entries.meaning: Air-vent temperature — no rise within 5 min of the 30-min dry phase (XQG50/HWD1000 combo platform)
entries.source: Haier XQG50-S1216 + Haier HWD1000 washer & dryer + Haier XQG50-S1016 manuals

entries.meaning: Dry temperature sensor — drying sensor circuit short/open (XQG50/HWD1000 combo platform)
entries.source: Haier XQG50-S1216 + Haier HWD1000 washer & dryer + Haier XQG50-S1016 manuals

entries.meaning: Memory function failure — EEPROM not functioning (XQG50/HWD1000 combo platform; bare "Warning" action)
entries.source: Haier XQG50-S1216 + Haier HWD1000 washer & dryer + Haier XQG50-S1016 manuals

entries.meaning: E5 = evaporator sensor failure (RM469 multi-door + upright platforms; RB470 split: condenser-compartment fan failure - different page).
entries.source: Hisense RM469N4AFEUK + RM469N4ACEUK user manuals; Hisense doc 895744-a1 (upright refrigerator/freezer)

entries.meaning: D1 (ERF-364/367 no-frost combis) = D-sensor open/short - freezer red LED blinks once; 30-min limit defrost fallback. Not the side-by-side d1.
entries.source: 2003 factory service manual "No-Frost Combi-Refrigerator ERF-364_367 ALL AR-EU MODELS", section 44

entries.meaning: E10 (= A10 on newer displays) = water inlet / fill fault - tap closed, kinked hose, clogged filter, or low pressure; E11/E12 sub-codes folded in.
entries.source: Haier official "Haier Dishwasher Fault Codes" (support.haier.com.au) + Haier HDW15U3S1 / HDW14G2X user manuals; Haier HDW15F4B1 User Manual (p.32)

entries.meaning: E4 = Overflow - highest priority; drain pump runs, buzzer 30 s; not an "overload" error (fabricated claim debunked).
entries.source: Daewoo DDW-MQ1214S TSM pp.28-30 + Daewoo EGSP-130E/13E/90E/9E TSM (manualslib p.50)

entries.meaning: E20 (= A20) = drainage fault - clogged filters, blocked drain, kinked hose, or undrilled sink spigot on new installs.
entries.source: Haier official "Haier Dishwasher Fault Codes" (support.haier.com.au) + Haier HDW14G2X user manual

entries.meaning: E30 (= F30) = overflow / anti-flood alarm - leak, inlet valve open and blocked, or blocked drain; switch off at wall + book a service.
entries.source: Haier official "Haier Dishwasher Fault Codes" (support.haier.com.au) + Haier HDW15U3S1 manual + F&P DW24U6I1 guide p.29; Haier HDW15F4B1 User Manual (p.32)

entries.meaning: E40 (= F40) = flow-meter fault; E41 same family, E42 = flow rate too high - book-a-service only.
entries.source: Haier official "Haier Dishwasher Fault Codes" (support.haier.com.au) + Fisher & Paykel DW24U6I1 User Guide p.29

entries.meaning: E50 (= F50) = electronics / communication fault between control boards - power-cycle once, then service.
entries.source: Haier official "Haier Dishwasher Fault Codes" (support.haier.com.au) + Fisher & Paykel DW24U6I1 User Guide p.29

entries.meaning: E60 (= A60, NOT F60) = heating fault - water not reaching temperature; book-a-service only.
entries.source: Haier official "Haier Dishwasher Fault Codes" (support.haier.com.au) + Fisher & Paykel DW24U6I1 User Guide p.29

entries.meaning: E70 (= A70) = temperature-sensing (NTC thermistor) fault - the sensor, not the heater (that is E60).
entries.source: Haier official "Haier Dishwasher Fault Codes" (support.haier.com.au) + F&P DW24U6I1 guide p.29 + Haier HDW15U3B1 manual

entries.meaning: E80 (= A80) = turbidity sensor fault - soil/cloudiness sensor faulty; E81/E82 sub-codes.
entries.source: Haier official "Haier Dishwasher Fault Codes" (support.haier.com.au) + F&P DW24U6I1 guide p.29 + Haier HDW15U3B1 manual

entries.meaning: E81 = turbidity sensor fault (competitor-documented as calibration out of range) - thin-documented, honestly flagged.
entries.source: Haier official "Haier Dishwasher Fault Codes" (support.haier.com.au) + F&P DW24U6I1 guide p.29 (parent A80)

entries.meaning: E82 = turbidity sensor signal fault, its own official row (competitor-documented as no stable signal).
entries.source: Haier official "Haier Dishwasher Fault Codes" (support.haier.com.au) + F&P DW24U6I1 guide p.29 (parent A80)

entries.meaning: R1 (ERF-364/367 combis) = R-sensor open/short - refrigerator red LED blinks once; RT-sensor fallback control.
entries.source: 2003 factory service manual "No-Frost Combi-Refrigerator ERF-364_367 ALL AR-EU MODELS", section 44

entries.meaning: RT (ERF-364/367 combis) = RT (room-temp) sensor open/short - refrigerator red LED blinks twice; system keeps running.
entries.source: 2003 factory service manual "No-Frost Combi-Refrigerator ERF-364_367 ALL AR-EU MODELS", section 44

entries.meaning: E6 = thermistor open-circuit failure - not a leak (competitor error debunked); E7 is its short-circuit pair.
entries.source: Daewoo DDW-MQ1214S TSM pp.28-30 + p.32 E6&E7 tree + Daewoo EGSP-130E/13E/90E/9E TSM (manualslib p.50)

entries.meaning: E7 = thermistor short-circuit failure - E6's pair; not a heater failure (competitor error debunked).
entries.source: Daewoo DDW-MQ1214S TSM pp.28-30 + p.32 E6&E7 tree + Daewoo EGSP-130E/13E/90E/9E TSM (manualslib p.50)

entries.meaning: E8 = diverter valve fault - no feed signal in 15 s or not positioned accurately in 60 s; diverter-equipped models only (wrong-appliance washer E8 debunked).
entries.source: Daewoo DDW-MQ1214S TSM pp.28-30 + Daewoo DDW-M1215 Instruction Manual p.19

entries.meaning: E0 = sensor keys not responding (RM469/RS711/RB470) or ambient/environment sensor defective (RS5P535/LS110EA/RB5P410/HRF266) - two meanings, model split.
entries.source: Hisense RM469N4AFEUK user manual (p.45); Hisense RS711N4ACE user manual (p.153); Hisense RB470N4CIC Instructions; Hisense RS5P535NTFE user manual (p.148); Hisense LS110EA Instructions for Use; Hisense RB5P410SACCUK user manual (p.35); Hisense HRF266N6CSE Service Manual (p.16)

entries.meaning: E1 = refrigerator (fresh-food) temperature sensor fault (E1/E2 share one row on the fan platform; E1 is the refrigerator sensor on the sensor platform).
entries.source: Hisense RM469N4AFEUK user manual (p.45); Hisense RS711N4ACE user manual (p.153); Hisense RB470N4CIC Instructions; Hisense doc 895744-a1 (RB424N4EFC); Hisense RS5P535NTFE user manual (p.148); Hisense LS110EA Instructions for Use; Hisense RB5P410SACCUK user manual (p.35); Hisense HRF266N6CSE Service Manual (p.16); Hisense HS-309 Service Instruction (2014-05-15)

entries.meaning: E2 = temperature sensor error or fault; on RB5P410, the refrigerator evaporator sensor. Undefined on RS5P535/LS110EA/HRF266.
entries.source: Hisense RM469N4AFEUK user manual (p.45); Hisense RS711N4ACE user manual (p.153); Hisense RB470N4CIC Instructions; Hisense doc 895744-a1 (RB424N4EFC); Hisense RB5P410SACCUK user manual (p.35); Hisense doc 962974en-a2 (troubleshooting section 28)

entries.meaning: E3 = compartment fan failure (RM469/RS711/doc 895744-a1) or freezer temperature sensor defective (RS5P535/LS110EA/RB5P410/HRF266). Undefined on RB470.
entries.source: Hisense RM469N4AFEUK user manual (p.45); Hisense RS711N4ACE user manual (p.153); Hisense doc 895744-a1 (RB424N4EFC); Hisense RS5P535NTFE user manual (p.148); Hisense LS110EA Instructions for Use; Hisense RB5P410SACCUK user manual (p.35); Hisense HRF266N6CSE Service Manual (p.16)

entries.meaning: E4 = compartment fan failure (RM469/RS711/RB470/895744-a1), evaporator sensor defective (RS5P535/LS110EA/RB5P410), or defrost sensor fault (HRF266/HS-309).
entries.source: Hisense RM469N4AFEUK user manual (p.45); Hisense RS711N4ACE user manual (p.153); Hisense RB470N4CIC Instructions; Hisense doc 895744-a1 (RB424N4EFC); Hisense RS5P535NTFE user manual (p.148); Hisense LS110EA Instructions for Use; Hisense RB5P410SACCUK user manual (p.35); Hisense HRF266N6CSE Service Manual (p.16); Hisense HS-309 Service Instruction (2014-05-15)

entries.meaning: E7 = ambient temperature sensor malfunctioning/fault (RS711/HS-309 only; undefined on RM469, RB470, RS5P535, LS110EA, RB5P410, HRF266).
entries.source: Hisense RS711N4ACE user manual (p.154); Hisense HS-309 Service Instruction (2014-05-15)

entries.meaning: E8 = sensor keys not responding (RM469/RS711/RB470); on HRF266 only, humidity sensor malfunctions. Undefined on RS5P535/LS110EA/RB5P410.
entries.source: Hisense RM469N4AFEUK user manual (p.45); Hisense RS711N4ACE user manual (p.153); Hisense RB470N4CIC Instructions; Hisense HRF266N6CSE Service Manual (p.16)

entries.meaning: E9 = door open too long / door sensor failure (RM469/RS711/RB470) or icemaker temperature sensor defective (RS5P535/LS110EA/HRF266).
entries.source: Hisense RM469N4AFEUK user manual (p.46); Hisense RS711N4ACE user manual (p.154); Hisense RB470N4CIC Instructions; Hisense RS5P535NTFE user manual (p.149); Hisense LS110EA Instructions for Use; Hisense HRF266N6CSE Service Manual (p.16)

entries.meaning: Eb = the icemaker is defective / ice maker malfunctions (RS5P535/LS110EA/HRF266). Not the same as E9 (icemaker temperature sensor).
entries.source: Hisense RS5P535NTFE user manual (p.149); Hisense LS110EA Instructions for Use; Hisense HRF266N6CSE Service Manual (p.16)

entries.meaning: Ec/Er = sensor keys not responding (RS5P535/LS110EA/RB5P410); on HRF266, Ec = communication sending malfunction, Er = communication receiving malfunction.
entries.source: Hisense RS5P535NTFE user manual (p.148); Hisense LS110EA Instructions for Use; Hisense RB5P410SACCUK user manual (p.34); Hisense HRF266N6CSE Service Manual (p.16)

entries.meaning: F1 = freezer (compartment) fan failure/malfunction (HRF266/RB5P410). A fan fault, not a sensor fault.
entries.source: Hisense HRF266N6CSE Service Manual (p.16); Hisense RB5P410SACCUK user manual (p.35)

entries.meaning: P5 = overcurrent protection of phase current for compressor (blink 15); compressor replacement is the last step, not the first.
entries.source: Gree Change 18/24 Service Manual, section 9.3 row 20; Gree Livo Gen4 Service Manual, section 9.1 row 27 + section 9.2(2); Gree GWH18QD Service Manual, section 9.1; GREE evo Owner's Manual, Malfunction Tab

entries.meaning: P6 = communication failure between main board and driver board (blink 16); can clear itself. Evo-era wall-split + U-Match only.
entries.source: GREE evo Split AC Owner's Manual, Malfunction Tab; Gree U-Match Series DC Inverter Service Manual, section 1.1 Table 1 row 35 + section 1.2

entries.meaning: P7 = malfunction of module temperature sensor circuit (blink 18); fix: replace outdoor control panel AP1. Not the same as P8.
entries.source: Gree Change 18/24 Service Manual, section 9.3 row 33; Gree Livo Gen4 Service Manual, section 9.1 row 29; Gree GWH18QD Service Manual, section 9.1; GREE evo Owner's Manual, Malfunction Tab

entries.meaning: P8 = module high temperature protection (blink 19); 20-min de-energize, thermal grease/radiator check, 80 C/95 C thresholds. Not the same as P7.
entries.source: Gree Change 18/24 Service Manual, section 9.3 row 34; Gree Livo Gen4 Service Manual, section 9.1 rows 30 + 33; Gree GWH18QD Service Manual, section 9.1; GREE evo Owner's Manual, Malfunction Tab; Gree GWC18MC Service Manual, section 5(8)

entries.meaning: H2 = static dedusting / static clearing dust protection (blink 2) - a status display, not a fault. Listed in R410A tables and in the Soyal R32 table (§9.1 row 32); VRF H2 differs.
entries.source: Gree Change 18/24 Service Manual, section 9.3 row 22; GREE evo Split AC Owner's Manual, Malfunction Tab; Gree GWH18TC-S3DBA1E Service Manual, Static Dedusting Function section; Gree Soyal GWH09/12/18AKC Service Manual (R32), section 9.1 row 32

entries.meaning: FA0 (FAO) = frequency synchronisation consistency check / electronics/power supply error - check whether other appliances in the home are misbehaving.
entries.source: Haier official support article "Haier Dishwasher Fault Codes" (support.haier.com.au, AU/NZ); Fisher & Paykel DW24U6I1 User Guide (p.29)

entries.meaning: FC0 (FCO) = wash pump error / motor fault (DW24U6I only per F&P) - switch OFF at the power supply, wait a few moments, switch ON again.
entries.source: Haier official support article "Haier Dishwasher Fault Codes" (support.haier.com.au, AU/NZ); Fisher & Paykel DW24U6I1 User Guide (p.29)

entries.meaning: A09 = sanitise cycle hasn't met temp needed to sanitise dishes - re-run the sanitise cycle; book a service if it faults again.
entries.source: Haier official support article "Haier Dishwasher Fault Codes" (support.haier.com.au, AU/NZ); Fisher & Paykel DishDrawer DD24SCTB9-N User Guide (p.49, DD*C models only)

entries.meaning: C8 = main PCB and human sensor communication failure (MDRB600MIC46P/MERB445MIC46, human-sensor BMF models only). Cooling continues.
entries.source: Midea MDRB600MIC46P User Manual (midea.com UK PDF), Fault indication table; Midea MERB445MIC46 User Guide (midea.com IT PDF), Fault indication table

entries.meaning: PA = AC current protection (input side) - input current exceeded the set value, system shuts down. U-Match/rooftop packaged only; VRF PA is a different fault.
entries.source: Gree U-Match Series DC Inverter Service Manual, R410A (GC201602-I), section 1.2 + section 2.2; Gree DC Inverter U-Match Series Service Manual, R32 (2019), section 3.3 row 33 + section 3.4.31; Gree Mini After-sales Service Manual, U-Match appendix (p.35); Gree ME33-42/G Owner's Manual

entries.meaning: PC = current detection (current sense) circuit error - offset-voltage average over 12.5% of 1.65V in 1s after power charging. U-Match/rooftop only; NOT 'Desynchronizing'.
entries.source: Gree U-Match Series DC Inverter Service Manual, R410A (GC201602-I), section 1.2 + section 2.2; Gree DC Inverter U-Match Series Service Manual, R32 (2019), section 3.3 row 34 + section 3.4.32; Gree Mini After-sales Service Manual, U-Match appendix (p.35); Gree ME33-42/G Owner's Manual

entries.meaning: PL = voltage of DC bus-bar is too low (blink 21); L-N below 150VAC, capacitor-C check, replace AP1. Not 185VAC; PH is too high, U3 is a voltage-drop event.
entries.source: Gree Change 18/24 Service Manual, section 9.3 row 36; Gree Mini After-sale Service Manual, Error Code List; Gree Livo+ Service Manual, section 9.1 p.40; Gree Rooftop Packaged Service Manual, section 5.1 + section 1.2

entries.meaning: PU = charging malfunction of capacitor (blink 17); 85% capacitor-voltage test, reactor (L) check, 20-min safety step; manuals replace the control board, not the capacitor.
entries.source: Gree Change 18/24 Service Manual, section 9.3 row 32 + section 9.4(2); Gree Mini After-sale Service Manual, Error Code List + section 9; Gree Rooftop Packaged Service Manual, section 5.1

entries.meaning: F2 = compartment fan failure (RB5P410 + doc 962974en-a2); display alone does not identify which fan. Gorenje-platform F2 = condenser fan; HR6CDFF support says room fan motor.
entries.source: Hisense RB5P410SACCUK user manual (p.35); Hisense doc 962974en-a2, INSTRUCTIONS FOR USE OF A REFRIGERATOR WITH FREEZER (troubleshooting section 28)

entries.meaning: F0 = condenser fan defective/malfunctioning (RB5P410 + doc 962974en-a2). Not a sensor fault; condenser fan sits at F2 on the Gorenje-platform set.
entries.source: Hisense RB5P410SACCUK user manual (p.35); Hisense doc 962974en-a2, INSTRUCTIONS FOR USE OF A REFRIGERATOR WITH FREEZER (troubleshooting section 28)

entries.meaning: En = WiFi module defective/malfunctioning (RB5P410 + doc 962974en-a2). No 'cannot operate normally' language; WiFi fault sits at 81 on the Gorenje-platform set.
entries.source: Hisense RB5P410SACCUK user manual (p.35); Hisense doc 962974en-a2, INSTRUCTIONS FOR USE OF A REFRIGERATOR WITH FREEZER (troubleshooting section 28)

entries.meaning: C1/C2/C3 = door open over 10 minutes (C1 freezer, C2 fridge, C3 both); else door sensor failure (RB5P410 + doc 962974en-a2). Not E9 or dr.
entries.source: Hisense RB5P410SACCUK user manual (pp.33-34); Hisense doc 962974en-a2, INSTRUCTIONS FOR USE OF A REFRIGERATOR WITH FREEZER (troubleshooting section 28)

entries.meaning: F90 = data/electronics error ('6' variants only: DW24U6I / DW60FC6 / DW60U6I). Power cycle, then Customer Care; no cause or further fix in any manual.
entries.source: Fisher & Paykel DW24U6I1 User Guide, p.29; Fisher & Paykel DW60FC models User Guide 591216C, pp.20-21 (official fisherpaykel.com PDF); Fisher & Paykel DW60U2I1 User Manual, p.31

entries.meaning: E08 = Door NTC: Overheat (BX B7S / BLED heat-pump tumble dryer). One Arcelik/Beko service handbook, two named platforms; service-test Steps 7/8/17; washer E08 is a different fault.
entries.source: BX B7S / BLED Heat Pump Tumble Dryer Service Handbook (Beko 2013; doc 2977720092_BX_BLED-B7S_HP_Service_Handbook, Sept '17), Error Codes table p.29 + Service Test Program sections 6-7

entries.meaning: Any F-code other than F01, F03, F13, F14 or F24 is an electronic module fault under the manuals' catch-all row.
entries.source: Hisense WFQP8014EVM User Manual, Fault Code List p.16 + section C; Hisense HWFL1014V User Manual; Hisense WDQR1014EVAJM User Manual (doc X08060925, p.12)

entries.meaning: U2 is compressor protection against loss of phase, shown by 12 blinks on evo-era units.
entries.source: GREE evo Split AC Owner's Manual, Malfunction Tab; Gree Mini After-sale Service Manual, blink-count table (split type / floor standing section)

entries.meaning: U3 is PN / DC bus-bar voltage drop protection caused by unstable supply voltage.
entries.source: GREE evo Split AC Owner's Manual, Malfunction Tab; Gree Change 18/24 Service Manual, section 9.3 row 35; Gree Livo Gen4 Service Manual, section 9.1 row 43; Gree Viola 09-12K Service Manual, section 9.1 row 45; Gree Soyal Service Manual, section 9.1 row 44; Gree Mini After-sale Service Manual, blink-count table; GWC18MC Service Manual, section 5

entries.meaning: U7 means the four-way (reversing) valve is abnormal and failed to change direction in heating.
entries.source: GREE evo Split AC Owner's Manual, Malfunction Tab; Gree Change 18/24 Service Manual, section 9.3 row 38; Gree Livo Gen4 Service Manual, section 9.1 row 45; Gree Viola 09-12K Service Manual, section 9.1 row 47; Gree Soyal Service Manual, section 9.1 row 46; Gree Mini After-sale Service Manual; Gree U-Match R410A Service Manual, section 1.1 row 32; Gree U-Match R32 Service Manual, section 3.3 row 27 + section 3.4.25; Gree Livo+ Service Manual, p.40

entries.meaning: U9 is a zero-crossing malfunction of the outdoor unit, also worded in the evo manual as an AC power zero voltage detect error.
entries.source: Gree Change 18/24 Service Manual, section 9.3 row 39; Gree Viola 09-12K Service Manual, section 9.1 row 48; Gree Soyal Service Manual, section 9.1 row 47; Gree Mini After-sale Service Manual; GREE evo Split AC Owner's Manual, Malfunction Tab

entries.meaning: Heating anti-high temperature drop frequency (blink 10) - all loads keep operating while the compressor frequency is decreased in heating.
entries.source: Gree Change 18/24 Service Manual, section 9.3 row 28 + section 9.4(4); GREE evo Split AC Owner's Manual, Malfunction Tab; Gree Soyal Service Manual, section 9.1 row 31

entries.meaning: Desynchronizing of compressor / compressor loss of step (blink 7) - compressor stops in cooling/drying while the indoor fan runs, and the whole unit stops in heating.
entries.source: Gree Change 18/24 Service Manual, section 9.3 row 27 + sections 9.4(3) and 9.4(6); GREE evo Split AC Owner's Manual, Malfunction Tab; Gree Livo Gen4 Service Manual, section 9.1 row 35; Gree Soyal Service Manual, section 9.1 row 37; Gree Mini After-sale Service Manual, Error Code List

entries.meaning: Pump failure (U-Match duct/cassette only) - after full-water protection has not recovered for a continuous 2 hours, all loads shut off and the fault cannot recover automatically.
entries.source: Gree U-Match Service Manual, GUHN09NK3AO, section 1 Trouble Table + Water Pump origin row; Gree U-Match Service Manual, GUHN09NK1AO, section 1 Trouble Table + Water Pump origin row

entries.meaning: LD means compressor loss of phase protection, with blink 12 in the Mini After-sale manual.
entries.source: GREE evo Split AC Owner's Manual, Malfunction Tab; Gree Mini After-sale Service Manual, Error Code List; Gree XK19 Wired Controller Manual, Table 4

entries.meaning: LE means compressor locked rotor protection, also called compressor stalling.
entries.source: GREE evo Split AC Owner's Manual, Malfunction Tab; Gree XK19 Wired Controller Manual, Table 4

entries.meaning: LA means outdoor fan 2 error protection, on dual-outdoor-fan units only, with L3 as fan 1.
entries.source: Gree Mini After-sale Service Manual, Error Code List (L3 row note); Gree XK19 Wired Controller Manual, Table 4

entries.meaning: E6 means an open or short circuit of the room or evaporator temperature sensor (T2).
entries.source: Midea Air Conditioner Error Codes Guide, R / 9V / 9A tables (manuals.plus); Midea Air Conditioner Error Codes and Troubleshooting Guide, Neola / Mission / Aurora / Altimate Comfort tables (manuals.plus); Midea Inverter Air Condition, Pridiom Multi-Zone service manual (PWM093HX / POM273HX); Midea Split Wall-Mounted Type Service Manual CSNA-1304-A, Corona Series, section 9.1

entries.meaning: E7 means outdoor fan speed out of control on 9V/9A and High Wall DB units, a T3 or T4 sensor fault on Mission, Aurora, Altimate and MSX midwall units, or an indoor EEPROM malfunction on cassette, ducted and floorstanding units.
entries.source: Midea Air Conditioner Error Codes Guide (manuals.plus); Midea Air Conditioner Error Codes and Troubleshooting Guide (manuals.plus); Midea High Wall System Error Codes and Fault Diagnosis Guide (manuals.plus)

entries.meaning: F4 means the outdoor unit EEPROM parameter error, the outdoor-PCB twin of E0.
entries.source: Midea High Wall System Error Codes and Fault Diagnosis Guide (manuals.plus); Midea Air Conditioner Error Codes and Troubleshooting Guide (manuals.plus); Midea Air Conditioner Error Codes Guide, MSMBB-12CRDN1-MP0W table (manuals.plus)

entries.meaning: F5 means the outdoor fan speed has gone out of control, for DC fan motors only.
entries.source: Midea High Wall System Error Codes and Fault Diagnosis Guide (manuals.plus); Midea Air Conditioner Error Codes and Troubleshooting Guide (manuals.plus); Midea Air Conditioner Error Codes Guide, MSMBB-12CRDN1-MP0W table (manuals.plus)

entries.meaning: E0 means the freezer air sensor has failed (open or short circuit).
entries.source: Arcelik BEKO COSMOS Service Handbook (SBS Cosmos refrigerator, G91631NE-G91634NE, REV NO: 01, 07.11.2018), section 13.1 (p.102); Arcelik BEKO G91629NWU Service Manual (FOUREVER 3-door, 36-inch wardrobe type refrigerator, REV NO: 01), section 9.1 (p.35)

entries.meaning: E1 means the freezer evaporator sensor has failed.
entries.source: Arcelik BEKO COSMOS Service Handbook (SBS Cosmos refrigerator, G91631NE-G91634NE, REV NO: 01, 07.11.2018), section 13.2 (p.103); Arcelik BEKO G91629NWU Service Manual (FOUREVER 3-door, 36-inch wardrobe type refrigerator, REV NO: 01), section 9.2 (p.36)

entries.meaning: E2 means the fridge (fresh-food) evaporator sensor has failed.
entries.source: Arcelik BEKO COSMOS Service Handbook (SBS Cosmos refrigerator, G91631NE-G91634NE, REV NO: 01, 07.11.2018), section 13.3 (p.104); Arcelik BEKO G91629NWU Service Manual (FOUREVER 3-door, 36-inch wardrobe type refrigerator, REV NO: 01), section 9.3 (p.37)

entries.meaning: E3 means the fridge (fresh-food) air sensor has failed.
entries.source: Arcelik BEKO COSMOS Service Handbook (SBS Cosmos refrigerator, G91631NE-G91634NE, REV NO: 01, 07.11.2018), section 13.4 (p.105); Arcelik BEKO G91629NWU Service Manual (FOUREVER 3-door, 36-inch wardrobe type refrigerator, REV NO: 01), section 9.4 (p.38)

entries.meaning: E4 means the freezer defrost heater has failed.
entries.source: Arcelik BEKO COSMOS Service Handbook (SBS Cosmos refrigerator, G91631NE-G91634NE, REV NO: 01, 07.11.2018), section 13.5 (p.106); Arcelik BEKO G91629NWU Service Manual (FOUREVER 3-door, 36-inch wardrobe type refrigerator, REV NO: 01), section 9.5 (p.39)

entries.meaning: E8 means the ice-maker (icematic) air sensor has failed.
entries.source: Arcelik BEKO COSMOS Service Handbook (SBS Cosmos refrigerator, G91631NE-G91634NE, REV NO: 01, 07.11.2018), section 13.6 (p.107); Arcelik BEKO G91629NWU Service Manual (FOUREVER 3-door, 36-inch wardrobe type refrigerator, REV NO: 01), section 9.6 (p.40)

entries.meaning: E9 means the ice-maker (icematic) motor has failed.
entries.source: Arcelik BEKO COSMOS Service Handbook (SBS Cosmos refrigerator, G91631NE-G91634NE, REV NO: 01, 07.11.2018), section 13.7 (p.108); Arcelik BEKO G91629NWU Service Manual (FOUREVER 3-door, 36-inch wardrobe type refrigerator, REV NO: 01), section 9.7 (p.41)

entries.meaning: E13 means the freezer fan has failed or is running at the wrong speed (cyclic freezer fan error).
entries.source: Arcelik BEKO COSMOS Service Handbook (SBS Cosmos refrigerator, G91631NE-G91634NE, REV NO: 01, 07.11.2018), section 13.8 (p.109); Arcelik BEKO G91629NWU Service Manual (FOUREVER 3-door, 36-inch wardrobe type refrigerator, REV NO: 01), section 9.8 (p.42)

entries.meaning: E15 means the condenser fan has failed or is running at the wrong speed (cyclic condenser fan error).
entries.source: Arcelik BEKO COSMOS Service Handbook (SBS Cosmos refrigerator, G91631NE-G91634NE, REV NO: 01, 07.11.2018), section 13.9 (p.110); Arcelik BEKO G91629NWU Service Manual (FOUREVER 3-door, 36-inch wardrobe type refrigerator, REV NO: 01), section 9.9 (p.43)
